_comment: THREE-YEAR test of the top-N MTF Confluence Lean 15m configs per coin. Replays each config from 2023-08-01 (or the coin listing date) through today.
_important: The lean 15m optimizer searched 2025-08-11 -> now. Everything BEFORE 2025-08-11 is genuinely out-of-sample; everything after is the window the configs were selected on. report.py splits the two.
_sizing: $1000 account, FIXED $1000 notional per trade (qty_pct_equity forced to 0). The live lean tree SEARCHES qty_pct_equity, so its net% partly measures leverage; this removes that.
